help.title: Game help
help.intro: Expand a topic to read it any time. The game continues while you read.
help.start: Your ship mines ore and attacks asteroids automatically. Draw your first skill for 50 ore. Later draws cost more as your skill collection grows.
help.partsTitle: How do parts and the lab work?
help.parts: Merge 5 iron and 2 crystals to upgrade the engine and reactor. In the lab, plasma upgrades voyage modules and relics fund permanent research. Only one module is active; switching has a 10-second cooldown.
help.prestige: Reach the displayed wave goal to gain dark matter and start a new voyage. Ore, iron, crystals, plasma, modules and contracts reset. Parts, skills, dark matter, relics, permanent research, permanent goal claims and route styles remain.
help.bossTitle: How do bosses and skill links work?
help.boss: A boss appears every 5 waves. After your first prestige, its weak module changes at 50% health. Compare the weakness hint with lab damage estimates. Collect two different linked skills to boost damage in that phase. Switching modules is optional.
help.offlineTitle: What happens while I am away?
help.offline: Receive up to 4 hours of ore at your departure mining rate. Combat, contracts and route mastery do not advance offline. Keep a backup code before deleting the app or changing devices. Store purchase restoration is separate from progress restoration.

ads.supplyLocked: Ad supply · unlock with first merge
help.adsTitle: How do ad supply and ad removal work?
help.ads: Optional ad supply unlocks with your first part merge. Complete a viewing to receive the larger of 120 seconds of mining or 20% of the next skill draw cost, calculated when you request it. The ore amount is shown before viewing; the next supply is available after 5 minutes. Supply ore does not count toward active-mining tasks. Interstitial ads may appear only after prestige reward feedback, after 10 minutes of active play since opening the app, at least 8 minutes apart and at most twice per app run. Removing interstitial ads keeps optional supply available.
